We just released ELDORION: GUARDIANS OF THE CYRSTALS DEMO on Steam. I hope you enjoy!
Check it out!
ELDORION: GUARDIANS OF THE CRYSTALS
Immerse yourself in an epic adventure with Eldoria: Crystals of Hope, a jRPG that blends tradition and innovation in a post-cataclysmic world.
Story
After a global cataclysm reshaped the Earth's geography, new continents emerged from the oceans, creating a new world to explore. Amidst this new era, meet Elena, a 17-year-old girl about to graduate from the Lumen Elemental School as a Light Elemental.
Elena's peaceful life is upended when her father, a renowned archaeologist, discovers one of the legendary Crystals of Hope in the mines of Lumen. Upon touching the crystal, Elena experiences vivid flashbacks of past lives she never knew existed. As she sets out to understand these visions, she learns that a planet is on a collision course with Earth. The key to preventing this disaster lies in uncovering the mysteries of her past and the true power of the Crystals of Hope.
Join Elena on her journey to uncover hidden truths, gather allies, and face epic challenges to ensure humanity's survival.
Gamepla
y
Fascinating Exploration: Discover a vibrant world in pixel art, filled with secrets, breathtaking landscapes, and memorable characters.
Turn-Based Battles: Engage in strategic and dynamic combat with a diverse cast of 15 playable characters.
Deep Narrative: Experience a rich and engaging story with fully voiced dialogues and an exciting anime-style introduction.
Classic jRPG Elements: Enjoy classic gameplay with a modern twist, including quests, puzzles, and character development.
Key Features
Captivating Pixel Art: Stunning visuals that combine nostalgia with innovation.
Voiced Dialogues: Full immersion with voices that bring characters and their stories to life.
Anime Introduction: A cinematic anime opening that sets the epic tone of the adventure.
Memorable Characters: Meet and recruit a diverse cast of allies, each with their own abilities and stories.
Prepare for the Journey
Eldoria: Crystals of Hope
offers an unforgettable experience for jRPG fans. With an exciting story, captivating graphics, and engaging gameplay, this is a game that must be in your collection.
Get Eldoria: Crystals of Hope on Steam and embark on this epic journey to save Earth! SOON DEMO WILL BE OUT and I Will be sharing the steam page here!

A Heartfelt Thanks to the RPG Maker Community – Eldoria: Crystals of Hope
Dear RPG Maker Forum Community,
We’re thrilled to share some exciting news with all of you! After years of hard work and dedication,
Eldoria: Crystals of Hope
is now live on Steam! This journey began in 2023 using the
RPG Maker MV
, and it’s thanks to tools like these and communities like yours that this dream has become a reality.
We poured our hearts into crafting this game, and we hope you’ll enjoy exploring our
pixel art world
, diving into the intricate story, and embracing the essence of what makes JRPGs so beloved.
Key Features to Look Forward To:
Three Languages
: English, Portuguese (BR), and Japanese.
Voice Acting
: Fully voiced in
English and Portuguese BR
for a truly immersive experience.
Demo Release
: The
demo
will be available starting
January 16th, 2024
, giving you a sneak peek into the adventure!
Special Offer for Game Channels:
We’d love to work with gaming content creators! If you’re a game channel and would like to promote
Eldoria
, we’re offering a
free Steam key
15 days before the game’s official release. It’s our way of saying thank you for helping us spread the word!
Support Our Journey on Steam
This is an independent project fueled by passion, and we can’t wait for you to experience it. However, to make the full release possible, we need
7,000 people to add Eldoria to their wishlists
.
Here’s how you can help:
Visit the
Eldoria: Crystals of Hope
page on Steam.
Add it to your
wishlist
.
Share it with fellow JRPG lovers and indie game enthusiasts!
Every addition to the wishlist brings us closer to launching a game we believe will resonate deeply with fans of the genre.
Thank you for being such an incredible community. Your love for RPGs inspires creators like us to push boundaries and tell new stories. We hope
Eldoria
will be a game you can truly cherish.
Let’s make this happen together!
With gratitude,
The Eldoria Team
